code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    markers = {(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 1}
    vertical = {c for r, c in markers if r == 0 and (h - 1, c) in markers}
    horizontal = {r for r, c in markers if c == 0 and (r, w - 1) in markers}
    for c in vertical:
        for r in range(h):
            out[r][c] = 1
    for r in horizontal:
        out[r] = [1] * w
    return out
'''
